div.p: The 24th edition of phpday takes place on May 13–14, 2027, at Hotel San Marco in Verona, Italy, and online. The conference is organized by GrUSP, and all talks are in English. Founded in 2003, phpday is one of the three longest-running PHP conferences in Europe and one of the four longest-running PHP conferences worldwide.

The call for papers is open through December 13, 2026. The organizers welcome talks rooted in real-world PHP development, from modernizing legacy codebases and exploring emerging technologies to building secure, high-performance applications and contributing to the open source ecosystem. You can submit up to three proposals.
Tickets for phpday 2027 are already on sale.
